name: bouncing-ball
prompt: Make a rubber ball (radius 0.25 m, red) that starts 2.5 m in the air above a floor and, in play mode, falls and bounces several times before settling. The floor is a flat 10 m square slab.

name: block-tower
prompt: Make a tower of five wooden crates (0.5 m cubes) stacked on a floor, which in play mode can be knocked over and picked up. The floor is a flat 12 m square slab. Give the crates grip (friction 0.8) so the tower stands.

name: ramp-and-rolling-ball
prompt: Make a ramp: a flat wooden board 3 m long and 1 m wide tilted 20 degrees so it slopes down toward +X, on a floor, with a ball (0.2 m radius) placed at the top of the ramp that will roll down it in play mode.
